matchingRule: Match only an exact PowerGo location from an official PowerGo page. Prices are dynamic and may differ by payment channel; never apply one site's tariff to another site.
notes: PowerGo explicitly states that charging tariffs are dynamic.
Using another app, charging card, or payment method can add surcharges or transaction fees; preserve the direct PowerGo tariff separately from roaming/eMSP pricing.
Do not mark PowerGo fully covered until Spanish locations are enumerated and their current official station tariffs are captured.
